column1: # This file maps individual SLO keys (as declared in the AppReferential Knowledge Graph
# and referenced in DeliveryMetrics User Journey slo_keys) to an estimated share of
# Decathlon's online GMV that would be AT RISK if that SLO were in full failure.
# gmv_share_pct: percentage of total online GMV that flows through user journeys
#   depending on this SLO. A value of 72.0 means ~72% of online GMV is at risk
#   if this SLO is fully degraded.
#   1. Get the failing product's SLO keys from the Knowledge Graph.
#   2. Look up each SLO key in this file.
#   3. Take the MAXIMUM gmv_share_pct across all matching SLO keys for the product
#      (avoids double-counting UJs that appear in multiple SLOs of the same product).
#   4. Multiply by the monthly GMV for the failure month (from monthly-gmv.csv).
#   5. Multiply by (failure_duration_minutes / 43200) to get the proportional loss.
# NOTE: Data is illustrative for demo purposes. Values are derived from UJ descriptions
# and e-commerce industry benchmarks. Update with real analytics data when available.
# SCOPE: France + top European markets (total online as per monthly-gmv.csv)

column5: OneFF availability API powers product availability checks on product pages and checkout. ~72% of online sessions query availability before or during purchase — if unavailable, customers cannot see stock and abandon checkout.

Kafka consumer processes real-time inventory and fulfillment events. High consumer lag blocks order processing and stock updates. Estimated 38% of orders are affected when lag exceeds threshold, particularly click-and-collect and same-day delivery orders.
OneCheckout API handles the complete online checkout flow. Any degradation blocks the final step of the purchase funnel for all online channels.
High payment latency leads to user abandonment at the payment step, affecting nearly all online transactions.
Payment session initialisation — without it no online purchase can be completed. 88% of online transactions require a successful payment session.
P95 payment API latency above threshold increases cart abandonment. Estimated 62% of online GMV is sensitive to payment latency (mobile-first customers are most affected).
Customer login is required for checkout in most flows. Login failure prevents purchase completion for authenticated users (~55% of online buyers use an account at checkout).
Order creation API — if orders cannot be created, purchases cannot be confirmed. Affects 80% of online GMV where order confirmation is required for dispatch.
Order status API powers order tracking pages. Failure does not block new purchases but degrades post-purchase experience.
Transaction ingestion from e-commerce channels. If blocked, sales data is not collected, but real-time purchase blocking depends on implementation.
Member profile API used for personalisation and loyalty. Failure degrades personalised experience but does not fully block purchase.
Invoice generation — failure prevents invoice delivery but does not block the purchase itself.
Return initiation API — failure prevents customers from initiating returns online. No direct new-purchase GMV impact.
